summary: Completed frontend testing of refactored RulesPage.jsx components and new StoragePage/FileManager system. All refactored rule section components (CulturesSection, OccupationsSection, EquipmentSection, PriceModifiersSection, RegionsSection) are working correctly with proper data-testid attributes. StoragePage with FileManager loads campaigns and allows campaign creation via modal.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for cultures without defined name tables - expected behavior, not a bug

EquipmentSection: Shows equipment tables with PDF export functionality and admin editing capabilities
PriceModifiersSection: Displays price modifiers by region, settlement, relationship, and context with calculation examples
RegionsSection: Region management with terrain difficulty and danger class badges, expandable for subregions
FileManager: Hierarchical file browser with campaign creation, file upload, search, and stats display
StoragePage: Clean wrapper for FileManager with navigation back button
